selectionRules: Keep at least one variant where partial receipt closure still leaves the platform gate in Review.
Keep at least one variant where platform import is Blocked before any publish packet is generated.
Prefer variants that change downstream publish targets, not only asset labels or counts.
Every generated variant must preserve synthetic public ids and relative artifact paths.
rejectionRules: Reject variants that make all publish targets Ready without adapter replay evidence.
Reject variants whose only change is AI narrative text.
Reject variants that remove owner receipts or hide residual risk.
